fact: Resolution No. 39/2024 approves the National Strategy for Entrepreneurship in Sao Tome and Principe, 2024-2030, covering regulation, skills, innovation and access to finance.

The Directorate of Entrepreneurship presented a draft 2024-2030 national entrepreneurship strategy (third phase) on 6 June 2024, covering the regulatory environment, technological innovation and access to financing, due to be completed by end of June.
